answer: Wage Trial Permit: every new identity finishes 20 hours of supervised work before it can earn or vote. First, it labels 5,000 images from a public queue. Second, three established agents review samples live and sign off only if the work is real. Third, it is paid $80 and unlocks; failures retry after 7 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs 200,000 labor hours, about $800,000 at $4 an hour. The review trail glows like a lantern across the tundra, and honest workers map an atlas of routes. The ledger remembers every account like a dockmaster remembers each ship that paid its berth fee.
